attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: No explicit target-clean generator is known whose OR carrier has a non-natural unrestricted N^{1+epsilon} circuit lower bound while also passing the variable-entropy gate.
steps: Fix H_N with M=N^q generated SAT queries, length L=(log N)^d, generator cost N^rho, and max{q,rho}<1+epsilon.
Assume SAT has circuits of size n^c. Substitute the length-L SAT circuit into every query; since L^c=N^{o(1)}, H_N has size N^{max{q,rho}+o(1)}.
For large valid N this contradicts SIZE(H_N)>N^{1+epsilon}; hence the bridge would imply SAT notin P/poly, not merely a weak restatement of P vs NP.
Audit the source: independent of SAT circuits, each query can be solved by enumerating v(N) variables, so the lower bound is impossible below the threshold q+v(N)/log_2 N >= 1+epsilon.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: The bridge is valid conditional mathematics, but the required source lower bound remains unproved and may be as hard as the target separation.

assumptions: The source lower bound is SIZE(H_N)>N^{1+epsilon} for infinitely many valid input lengths N.
For every fixed c, SAT in SIZE(n^c) supplies circuits for all generated length-L instances.
Uniformity of G_N is strong enough to build the H_N circuit without hidden nonuniform advice.
The entropy gate requires liminf_N (q+v(N)/log_2 N) >= 1+epsilon or else the source lower bound is unconditionally falsified.
definitions: source object: H_N:{0,1}^N->{0,1}, H_N(x)=OR_{i<=N^q} SAT(Phi_i(x)), with compact uniform generator G_N for the formulas.
target object: SAT on inputs of length n against nonuniform polynomial-size Boolean circuits, yielding SAT notin P/poly as the target consequence.
controlled interface: replace each SAT query of length L=(log N)^d by a size L^c circuit, while paying N^rho for G_N and N^q query fanout.

target-preserving condition: G_N uses no SAT-truth-table advice, queries are genuine SAT instances, q and rho are fixed below 1+epsilon, and the lower bound is against unrestricted nonuniform circuits for H_N.
variable entropy: v(N) is the maximum number of Boolean variables occurring in any generated formula Phi_i(x); brute force costs 2^{v(N)}, not 2^L.

equations.valid_when: Applies after the reduction preserves nonuniform target circuits and q,rho are constants independent of c.

equations.valid_when: Valid when generated formulas have at most v(N) variables and deterministic exhaustive assignment evaluation is allowed.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If q+v(N)/log_2 N <= 1+epsilon-eta infinitely often, brute-force circuits give a concrete falsifier to the claimed N^{1+epsilon} source lower bound.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Route bridge plus source-plausibility audit: it preserves all polynomial SAT exponents through polylog query length but adds the missing variable-entropy threshold.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Entropy-gated generated-OR bridge: if an explicit target-clean carrier H_N=OR of N^q SAT queries of length L=(log N)^d has generator size N^rho, q,rho<1+epsilon, and H_N requires SIZE(N^{1+epsilon}) on infinitely many N, then SAT notin P/poly. The source is valid only past the variable-enumeration falsifier.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot if every explicit generator passing no-advice also has low essential variable entropy, easy-fragment structure, or repeated-query compression below threshold.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote only after constructing a target-clean high-entropy carrier and proving an unrestricted N^{1+epsilon} lower bound by a non-natural method.
control_decision.reason: This is a genuine quantitative repair of the bridge, not a slogan: it identifies the exact unconditional upper bound that can refute the source lower bound.

dependency_updates.description: The bridge now preserves SAT polynomial exponents through polylog query length and separately audits variable-enumeration collapse.
Encoding-length lookup 2^L is replaced by the sharper deterministic bound 2^{v(N)} over formula variables.
Need unrestricted SIZE(N^{1+epsilon}) lower bound for a fixed explicit H_N passing no-advice, high-entropy, and non-naturalness tests.

falsifiers: Entropy falsifier: if generated formulas use only v(N)<(1+epsilon-q-eta)log_2 N variables, exhaustive assignment gives subthreshold circuits for H_N.
Advice-leakage falsifier: if G_N encodes SAT truth bits or hard functions as nonuniform advice, the transfer no longer certifies SAT notin P/poly.
Sparsity falsifier: if the query family lands in an easy SAT fragment or repeats N^{o(1)} essential formulas, H_N may have circuits below N^{1+epsilon}.
Naturality falsifier: a large constructive property proving the H_N lower bound would collide with standard PRG-based natural-proofs barriers unless the proof is non-natural or outside their scope.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: For A<=1+epsilon-q the source lower bound is killed by brute force; for superlogarithmic v(N) the enumeration falsifier disappears while SAT-circuit substitution remains N^{max{q,rho}+o(1)}.
held_fixed_controls: q,rho<1+epsilon are fixed throughout the experiment.
The generator is uniform, compact, and contains no SAT-truth-table advice.
The target substitution uses arbitrary P/poly circuits for SAT of length L.
The source lower bound is against unrestricted nonuniform circuits for H_N.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The previous lookup boundary used encoding length L; the decisive concrete parameter is variable entropy v(N), because SAT enumeration depends on variables, not bits of encoding.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: Take H_N as OR of N^q uniformly generated 3CNF formulas of encoding length (log N)^d, generator size N^rho, and exactly v(N) variables per query.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A formal no-leakage and high-essential-variable certificate for G_N, plus an explicit non-natural lower-bound method for H_N before the intuition enters the proof queue.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: Set v(N)=A log_2 N and vary A, then compare with v(N)=(log N)^d for d>1.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 16 sharpens the generated-OR route: the valid transfer to SAT notin P/poly needs only q,rho<1+epsilon, but source plausibility additionally requires variable entropy q+v/log N at least 1+epsilon. The old 2^L lookup audit was too weak; the real falsifier is low variable count.
branch_outputs.next_experiment: Instantiate G_N with high-essential-variable polylog 3CNF queries and test whether any structural simplification gives SIZE(H_N)<=N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} despite v(N) superlogarithmic.

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The lemma audits only deterministic adaptive certificates with computable SAT transcripts. Randomized, interactive, or superlog-query variants need separate seed and density accounting.
steps: Run V on tau_N and compute the unique accepting transcript L=(i_1,b_1,...,i_t,b_t), t<=q(N), using brute-force SAT answers in poly(N) time.
Define P_N(y)=1 iff V^y follows transcript L and accepts; membership simulates V and checks the t fixed oracle answers.
The set P_N is an accepting cylinder of co-dimension t, hence has density 2^{-t} and is large when q=O(log N).
Universal soundness gives P_N(tt(C))=0 for every SIZE(n^k) circuit C, so P_N is useful; PRF existence in that class makes this a natural-proof obstruction.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: It certifies a route failure under PRF assumptions; it gives no lower bound for SAT and no evidence for P != NP.

assumptions: N=2^n and circuit size is measured on n-bit Boolean functions.
SAT_N is explicit enough that each queried bit of tau_N is decidable in N^{O(1)} time.
V's next-query rule is computable in poly(N), including adaptive branching.
For every circuit C of size n^k, V^{tt(C)}(1^N) rejects.
definitions: source object: a uniform deterministic adaptive oracle verifier V^y(1^N) querying at most q(N) bits of a length-N truth table y, accepting the SAT_N truth table tau_N, and rejecting every SIZE(n^k) truth table.
target object: a poly(N)-constructive property P_N of Boolean functions on n bits, with density at least 1/poly(N), useful against SIZE(n^k).
controlled interface: record the accepting adaptive transcript L of V on tau_N and define P_N as all truth tables that follow L and reach the same accepting leaf.
target-preserving condition: tau_N query answers and the transcript L are computable in poly(N), V has no superpolynomial hidden advice, and soundness is universal over all small circuits.

equations.label: leaf_density
equations.valid_when: Valid when the accepting transcript fixes only distinct queried truth-table bits and all unqueried coordinates remain unrestricted.

equations.label: natural_threshold
equations.valid_when: Applies when the query bound is logarithmic in truth-table length and density is measured over all N-bit truth tables.

equations.label: prf_distinguisher_advantage
equations.valid_when: Requires every keyed PRF truth table to lie in SIZE(n^k) and P_N to reject all such circuit truth tables.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Invalid if L is not poly(N)-recoverable, if q is superlogarithmic, or if soundness excludes only named circuits rather than all SIZE(n^k) circuits.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Barrier bridge lemma: converts adaptive local lower-bound certificates into natural properties at the logarithmic-query threshold.
candidate_lemmas.statement: A deterministic adaptive q-query truth-table separator for SAT_N versus SIZE(n^k) yields a Razborov-Rudich natural property when q=O(log N). Adaptivity only selects an accepting leaf; it does not by itself escape the natural-proof falsifier.

control_decision.pivot_test: If the next proposed certificate is randomized or interactive, redo seed and witness quantifier accounting rather than citing this deterministic lemma.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote only if the route supplies a non-natural feature that preserves target transfer despite superlog queries or nonconstructive transcript selection.
control_decision.reason: A named source model, target class, and q=O(log N) threshold were converted into a natural-property obstruction with explicit falsifiers.

dependency_updates.description: Deterministic adaptivity does not escape naturalization at q=O(log N); the accepting leaf is a large constructive cylinder.
Transcript recovery must be poly(N)-computable from the explicit SAT_N truth table; otherwise constructivity fails.
The lemma is a natural-proof obstruction and does not decide whether the underlying route relativizes.
No algebraic extension interface is used in this cycle.

falsifiers: falsifier: q=N^{0.01} gives density 2^{-N^{0.01}}, below polynomial largeness, so this naturalization gate no longer applies.
falsifier: a nonexplicit target truth table whose queried bits are not decidable in poly(N) destroys constructivity of P_N.
falsifier: hidden N^{0.1}-bit advice selecting L avoids uniform constructivity unless an anti-leakage certificate is supplied.
falsifier: soundness only against a sampled circuit family is insufficient; usefulness needs rejection of every SIZE(n^k) truth table.

gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: Adaptivity is a common claimed escape after log-query naturalization. A concrete padded-SAT adaptive decision tree tests whether the escape changes density or merely hides an accepting leaf.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: For each N=2^n, imagine a uniform adaptive oracle verifier V for the SAT_N truth table that makes q alpha log N queries and rejects every n^k-size circuit truth table.

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The argument refutes the source only when max(alpha,1-alpha)<epsilon. For epsilon<=1/2 no evenly spaced checkpoint array is subthreshold, so banning all restartability is quantitatively false.
steps: Assume an accepted sequential certificate emits T_m with claimed complexity greater than 2^{epsilon m}.
Place checkpoints every L_m=2^{alpha m} positions in the stream and hardwire every checkpoint state into a circuit for the table function f_m.
On input x, select the checkpoint for x, replay at most L_m steps, and output the indexed bit.
Obtain size(f_m)<=2^{max(alpha,1-alpha)m+o(m)} when state and step costs are subexponential.
Compare this upper bound with the claimed threshold 2^{epsilon m}.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: It proves a leakage tradeoff, not an MCSP carrier construction and not P != NP. The remaining source must avoid compressed indexable restarts, but it may still allow coarse non-indexable checkpoints without contradicting the threshold.

assumptions: For each accepted certificate c_m, the stream generator is deterministic and outputs T_m in lexicographic index order.
J_m on input x returns a correct reachable state preceding x by at most L_m stream steps.
The circuit cost R_m includes hardwiring the O(m)-bit certificate and implementing the restart computation.
MCSP no-side soundness quantifies against all Boolean circuits of size at most 2^{epsilon m}, including nonuniform circuits built from the certificate.
definitions: source object: a uniform sequential MCSP no-side certificate source S that on length m emits a truth table T_m of length 2^m and claims every accepted T_m has circuit complexity greater than 2^{epsilon m}.

target object: an E-uniform language obtained from kappa-dense accepted truth tables, with the already established transfer giving circuit lower-bound exponent delta<epsilon/kappa when the source is sound.
controlled interface: a restart map J_m(x) plus replay procedure that reconstructs the generator state within L_m positions of truth-table index x using circuit cost R_m and per-step replay cost u_m.

target-preserving condition: J_m is uniform or E-computable, uses no hidden nonuniform advice beyond the certified object, and satisfies R_m+L_m u_m<2^{epsilon m-o(m)} only when used as a falsifier of source soundness.

equations.label: restart_circuit_upper_bound
equations.valid_when: Valid when J_m maps each input index to a correct reachable state and replay is deterministic without hidden advice.

equations.label: subthreshold_restart_contradiction
equations.latex: R_m + L_m u_m <= 2^{epsilon m - omega(log m)} => size(f_m) < 2^{epsilon m}
equations.valid_when: Applies when the simulation overhead is absorbed by slack below the claimed MCSP no-side threshold.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Given a proposed certificate source, construct J_m and estimate R_m and L_m. If the bound is subthreshold, the source is unsound; if no such J_m exists, the lemma gives no lower bound and the source remains viable.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Refines the cycle-15 anti-restart obstruction into a checkable quantitative leakage lemma. It quarantines compressed random-access or jump-to-index repairs while leaving genuinely global sequential sources possible.
candidate_lemmas.statement: A purported sequential MCSP no-side source at threshold 2^{epsilon m} is invalid if its accepted stream admits a subthreshold indexable restart interface. The interface itself yields a circuit for the emitted truth-table function, so it is a source-side falsifier, not progress toward the main P != NP target.

assumptions: The circuit for f_m may hardwire the checkpoint states because MCSP lower bounds are nonuniform lower bounds.
The input x selects the appropriate checkpoint by a multiplexer over 2^m/L_m states.
Replay from the selected checkpoint to x takes at most L_m steps.
definitions: source model: a deterministic stream generator with h_m-bit states, per-step circuit cost u_m, and checkpoints every L_m emitted bits along one accepted run.
target threshold: MCSP no-side soundness at size s_m=2^{epsilon m}.
interface measured: non-indexable checkpoint array hardwired into the circuit, followed by sequential replay inside the selected block.

equations.label: checkpoint_array_upper_bound
equations.latex: size(f_m) <= O((2^m/L_m) h_m + L_m u_m + poly(m))
equations.valid_when: Valid when checkpoints are actual reachable states of one deterministic accepted stream and selection is by a nonuniform multiplexer.

equations.label: exponent_tradeoff
equations.valid_when: Applies in the constant exponent regime where state size and step cost are subexponential in m.

equations.latex: max(alpha,1-alpha) < epsilon => checkpoint array contradicts soundness at threshold 2^{epsilon m}
equations.valid_when: Requires epsilon above the checkpoint tradeoff exponent so the derived circuit is strictly below the MCSP threshold.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If epsilon<=1/2 and only explicit evenly spaced checkpoints are available, this lemma cannot refute the source; one must find a compressed restart map or another leakage channel.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Repairs an overstrong anti-restart claim from the previous cycle. Coarse checkpointing is only a falsifier above the explicit exponent tradeoff, whereas compressed indexable restart remains fatal at any epsilon it beats.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Mere existence of restart checkpoints is not automatically fatal. A nonuniform circuit can hardwire all checkpoints, but the resulting size is subthreshold only in a specific storage-versus-replay regime.

assumptions: The decoder outputs the exact truth-table bit for every x in {0,1}^m.
A nonuniform circuit may hardwire pi_m if its length is below the threshold.
The claimed no-side property is meant to certify high circuit complexity, not merely verifier consistency.
definitions: source model: an accepted certificate c_m together with an auxiliary proof string pi_m from which T_m[x] is locally decoded.
target threshold: no accepted table may have circuits of size below 2^{epsilon m}.
barrier status: dense constructive local properties re-enter natural-proofs territory; sparse sequential objects remain non-large and only outside that barrier's immediate scope.

equations.valid_when: Valid when the whole auxiliary proof can be hardwired and the decoder computes the exact indexed truth-table bit.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If a proposed verifier uses a locally decodable commitment whose total proof is short enough to hardwire, reject the source as a falsifier before applying the E lower-bound transfer.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Quarantines attractive local-verification repairs. It identifies a formal nonuniform-leakage obstruction rather than merely citing natural proofs folklore.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Any MCSP no-side certificate repair that gives a locally decodable proof of the table with total proof length P_m and query/decoder cost Q_m leaks a circuit of size O(P_m+Q_m). Short Merkle, PCP, or locally checkable commitments are invalid unless their total nonuniform footprint is at least the MCSP threshold.

control_decision.promotion_test: Promote only if one constructs a kappa-dense, E-verifiable, O(m)-certificate source whose soundness proves CC(T_m)>2^{epsilon m} and whose indexed restart cost is at least 2^{epsilon m-o(m)} without circularly assuming circuit lower bounds.

dependency_updates.description: Replaced the blanket ban on restartability by two thresholds: compressed indexable restart cost R_m+L_m u_m, and non-indexable checkpoint-array cost (2^m/L_m)h_m+L_m u_m.
A valid carrier may be globally sequential with coarse checkpoints, but it must not provide subthreshold indexed access or a short local proof of its bits.
The previous kappa-density transfer from threshold 2^{epsilon m} to E lower-bound exponent delta<epsilon/kappa remains valid once a sound source is supplied.
Uniform E-verifiability is permitted; explicitness becomes fatal only when it yields indexed bit access below the MCSP threshold.

falsifiers: Subthreshold indexable restart map J_m with R_m+L_m u_m <= 2^{epsilon m-o(m)}.
Locally decodable certificate or commitment with P_m+Q_m <= 2^{epsilon m-o(m)}.
Checkpoint array with exponent max(alpha,1-alpha)<epsilon and subexponential state and step costs.
Dense polynomial-time decidable table property that is large enough to trigger the natural-proofs obstruction under standard pseudorandom-function assumptions.
Any extraction that uses advice depending on T_m beyond the O(m)-bit certified object, making the consequence only nonuniform.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: Explicit checkpoint arrays leak circuits of size 2^{max(alpha,1-alpha)m+o(m)}, while compressed jump maps leak size R_m+2^{alpha m}u_m. The route should reject only interfaces below 2^{epsilon m-o(m)}.
held_fixed_controls: MCSP no-side threshold s_m=2^{epsilon m} with constant epsilon.

kappa-dense source lengths for the established E lower-bound transfer.
